}}'''Mailaine Harvole''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] who lived after the [[Breaking of the World]] and at the time of the founding of the [[White Tower]]. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Mailaine Harvole}}

==History==
Circa {{Ab|47}}, Mailaine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ''ajah'' (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

It is highly likely that Mailaine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of {{ab|47}}, because from a letter dated {{Ab|77}}, it is stated that after the [[stilling]] of [[Lideine Rajan]], Mailaine ceased her resistance and led her followers to kneel.{{ref||bwb 9}}

It is not known if also Mailaine was stilled or instead enrolled in the White Tower.
